doc.title: Milt Fillius interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 18, 2000

title: Monk Rowe opens the interview at Hamilton College
summary: Rowe introduces Fillius as the driving force behind the archive and says he wants to fill in gaps about his life.

story.theme_name: Opening the interview: Monk Rowe's welcome and archive boilerplate
story.community_name: Opening the Hamilton College interview: introductions and boilerplate

blocks.x: It’s a special day because we’re filming at Hamilton College for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive and I’m very, very pleased to have Milt Fillius with me today who is the driving force behind this effort.
My pleasure. We had a time doing it.
Right. I’ve known you for about, over five years now, but there’s a lot of holes in what I know about you. And you may prefer it that way.
Well there are some holes that will remain holes.
Okay. So we’ll just fill in a few blanks if you don’t mind, and then we’ll get to talk about the archive. I know you come from Rochester.
And when you were in your teens that was the swing era starting.
